Subject: Exec retreat: health & safety checklist + short-notice response plan

Team,

We're three weeks out from the Acme executive offsite (Mar 12–14). I pulled together a first-pass health & safety checklist and a short-notice response framework so we have a clear single source for on-site escalation and vendor responsibilities. Draft attached: exec-retreat-health-safety-checklist-v1.pdf.

Key asks:
- Facilities (Acme): please confirm the on-site medical clinic's 24/7 contact and nearest ER (name & address).
- Skyline Travel (Emma): confirm standby transport options and a list of emergency-approved vendors for ground transport.
- Ops (Markus & Vanessa): review the short-notice response roles (first responder, comms lead, exec liaison) and flag any overlaps with onsite security.
- Lauren: can you confirm the final attendee list this Friday so I can create emergency contact cards?

Top-line items in the checklist:
- Onsite medical point-of-contact, nearest ER, and telemedicine line
- Onsite first aid kits + AED locations and inventory
- Evacuation assembly point + primary/secondary routes
- Severe weather & travel disruption triggers and decision matrix
- Communication templates for participants (injury, evacuation, advisory)

I'll collect responses and produce a one-page pocket card for executives and staff. If anyone has local advisories or clinic contacts, add them inline or attach.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec-retreat-health-safety-checklist-v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Exec retreat: health & safety checklist + short-notice response plan

Thanks, Evelyn — useful start. A few additions from ops:

1) Short-notice response matrix: attach a quick draft (short-notice-response-matrix.xlsx). It maps incident severity to required roles (on-site lead, security, medical, comms, execs to notify) and expected SLA for response.

2) Local clinic: Dr. Rafael Gomez at City Clinic (24/7 urgent line: +1-415-555-0199). Nearest ER is St. Vincent's (8 miles, 12–15 min drive).

3) Weather: forecast calls for potential coastal storms in the week prior — add a "travel freeze" trigger: if sustained cancellation rate >20% or airport closures in destination region, we push to remote or shift schedule by 24h.

4) Medication & dietary restrictions: ops will compile a confidential list from Lauren to include on emergency cards.

I attached the matrix for review.

-Markus
Operations Lead, Events
Redwood Inference
